# Upstream notices

The RTL is generated from Chipyard and its pinned dependencies. Original
license texts are copied without changes into `licenses/`, grouped by source
repository. The component commits and license hashes are recorded in
[`generation.json`](../docs/artifacts/generation.json).

This includes the CPU/SoC components used by IP1, plus FFTGenerator, dsptools,
fixedpoint and rocket-dsp-utils. Generated RTL retains its source comments.
`LICENSE.SiFive` is also provided alongside the RTL resources that reference it.
No new blanket license is assigned to upstream code. Tool binaries and technology
libraries are external and are not redistributed here.
